summary: If delegated iterator has no return method, an outer return completes directly with the outer return value.

tests.name: missing return preserves outer value
tests.input: const inner={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; function* g(){yield* inner} const it=g();it.next();console.log(it.return(8));

tests.name: no extra inner next on return
tests.input: let n=0;const inner={next(){n++;return {value:1,done:false}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}};function* g(){yield* inner}const it=g();it.next();it.return();console.log(n);
